text.p: Turkey's new government revised its target for gross national product growth in 1997 up to 5.5-6 percent from an earlier target of four percent, new finance ministry figures showed on Wednesday.
The end-1997 inflation target was revised up to 80-85 percent from a previous target of 57.7 percent, the ministry figures showed.
The target for exports in 1997 was revised to $25.5-26 billion from $29.5 billion and the import target was revised to $45.5-46 billion from $50 billion.
The current account deficit was targetted to reach $4-4.5 billion in 1997, compared with an earlier target of $5.6 billion.
